title: Business meeting to consider S.5289, to protect the right to the free exercise of religion, and the nominations of Trevor Scott Pemberton, to be United States District Judge for the Northern District of Oklahoma, Zachary Paul West, to be United States District Judge for the Eastern District of Oklahoma, and Scott Krueger, of Indiana, to be United States Marshal for the Northern District of Indiana.
